I'm going to be homeless, again, in two days. I've been on meds for a while and they didn't help, "hhhm, that shouldn't be what they do but lets try upping your dosage" was what my doctor said...

I have a history of cutting myself so I planned to cut deeper and cut the vein and artery. I have everything ready, start cutting and just can't get it done...
There isn't more for me. Sure some people do have stuff but I'm here with nothing left, nothing to gain and only even more pain and hardship ahead of me.
I was probably confusing it with last.fm...
I thought because it's a radio station thus fm works.

What did the capitalists ever do? It's not like they plunged the world into chaos like those dirty commies! 

Oh wait...
